Notes_and_Tips: Prefer light meals during night shift; avoid heavy fried foods at night.
Control portion sizes and prioritize protein for satiety.
Keep easy snacks ready to avoid late-night overeating.
Aim for walking or light stretching between shifts.
Choose grilled or boiled non-veg over fried varieties.
Stay hydrated and keep meal timings as consistent as possible.
